asks: Would you rather I stood over there?
Do you want me to say something? I can.
description: A person is standing well inside the distance people stand at. They are perfectly ordinary in every other respect, which is the part that will not sit still in your head.
emotes: {it} takes a small step that leaves the distance unchanged.
{it} breathes in time with you, and you notice, and it continues.
looks: Their face is arranged pleasantly and holds the arrangement for longer than faces do.
They have not blinked since you started counting, and you started counting some time ago.
Whenever you shift your weight they are exactly as close as they were.
name: somebody standing much too close
says: This is a normal amount of space.
Carry on. I am not stopping you.
